candidate_space.sampler: Sobol(d=3, scramble=True), one child stream per family
candidate_space.inversion: w_Nb = S/(1+R*M_Cr/M_Nb); w_Cr = S - w_Nb (frozen FULL_V1)

objectives.A_maximize: pred Cr partition to FCC at 950 C (Cr_FCC_950)
objectives.B_maximize: pred useful Cr release: Delta_Cr_FCC = Cr_FCC(950) - Cr_FCC(450)
objectives.C_constraint: pred C15 family volume fraction within the moderate band at BOTH 450 C and 600 C (band below); NOT maximized
objectives.D_minimize: pred Cr partition to OTHER_SOLID at 450 C (Cr_OTHER_450)
objectives.E_constraint: pred LIQUID family fraction <= 0.01 at every screening temperature (hard QA; in-domain liquid fraction is 0)
objectives.F_filter: OOD applicability (below) - hard filter, not an objective

moderate_c15_band.rule: middle quantile band (q0.25, q0.75) of NON-ZERO C15 family volume fraction, FULL_V1 Domain A, 450+600 C pooled

ood_filter.rule: mean 5-NN Euclidean distance (600 C embedding) to STEP5A DEV_TRAIN composition rows <= 1.50
ood_filter.reference: STEP5A DEV_TRAIN rows at 600 C from FULL_V1_CANDIDATE_FEATURES (frozen)
ood_filter.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on the reference rows only (geometry convention from frozen STEP5E maximin; not a model scaler)
ood_filter.note: threshold fixed pre-ranking and documented, not tuned

pareto_protocol.method: non-dominated sorting (maximize A, B; minimize D) over the APPLICABLE set (C, E, F satisfied)
pareto_protocol.family_fairness: both global and per-family fronts are reported; no family may silently fill the finalist list (spec 27)

diversity_selection.method: deterministic maximin diversity within the global Pareto set, in (S_CrNb, R_CrNb_atomic, X_wt_pct) scaled space
diversity_selection.rule: iterate families round-robin; within a family pick the Pareto member maximizing the minimum scaled distance to already-picked finalists; ties -> lexicographically smallest candidate_id; stop at 5 per family or 30 total; if a family's applicable Pareto set has fewer than 3 members, take all of them and report the shortfall

confirmation.engine: Thermo-Calc 2025b / TC-Python 2025.2.30 / TCCU6 v6.2, 1 bar, 1 mol, wt.%, Cu balance, equilibrium only (frozen FULL_V1 runner)
confirmation.label: POST-FREEZE NON-Ni screening confirmation; NOT a blind test; never used to retrain or retune anything (spec 13, 34)

amendments.what: diversity-selection finalist pool clarified: each family's OWN Pareto front is the pool (the global front alone was ZR-only by domination); families with <3 front members extend with their next family_pareto_rank values to reach the preregistered 3-per-family minimum
amendments.why: STEP5K brief spec 27-28 requires 3-5 finalists per family; made BEFORE any Thermo-Calc confirmation state exists; changes no objective, constraint, threshold or model
